title: 第15章 古林寻佳处 高台筑新家第16章 翠影诛巨鼠 灵餐破凡阶
lines: 在无尽东海万顷碧波之上，矗立着一座广袤无垠、神秘莫测的庞然大物——琉璃岛。
这座岛屿大得超乎想象，高山横亘、深谷隐匿、沼泽连绵、林海滔滔，潜藏着无数未知凶险与机缘。
可即便如此辽阔，罗止正与李紫云自穿越登岛以来，拼尽全力、浴血求生，也仅仅踏足了这座岛屿最边缘、最外围的一隅，而这片区域，正是他们眼下一步步探索、即将走完的碧叶林。
细碎柔和的光线穿透层层翠叶，在地面洒下斑驳晃动的绿影。罗止正手持盘根铁木枪，玄铁枪尖泛着沉稳冷冽的微光，腰间骨刀贴身悬挂，步伐稳健地走在前方开路，眼神锐利而沉稳，每一步都踩得扎实谨慎。
李紫云背负十支盘根铁木箭，手握盘根铁木弓，紧紧跟在他身后。曾经遇事便心慌、受伤便眼红的女孩，如今眉眼间多了几分坚韧，握弓的手稳定有力，目光警惕却不再慌乱，已然能稳稳伴在他身侧，成为可靠的同伴。
两人自北面盘根石岗出发，一路向着碧叶林中央方位前行，约莫一炷香工夫，终于踏入了碧叶林最后一片、也是最核心的区域。
此地古木参天，株株皆需数人合抱，树干笔直如铸，直插天际。树冠层层叠叠、交织相连，撑开无边无际的天然华盖，将烈日、狂风、暴雨尽数隔绝在外。林间地势平缓开阔，无陡峭山崖，无杂乱荆棘，无泥泞洼地，更无盘根石岗那般嶙峋碎石，唯有巨木粗壮的根系错落隆起，在地面铺成天然高台与蜿蜒小径，行走其上平稳踏实，不易滑倒，亦不易迷路。
空气中没有密林深处惯有的潮湿腐臭，只有草木清香与温润灵气萦绕，四下安静得只剩枝叶轻响、微风低吟。
这里，正是碧叶林中央——翠影高台。
此地坐落于无尽东海沿岸密林东侧，与无尽东海沿岸浅滩直线相距约十三公里。
两人越往深处走，周遭环境愈发安宁，杂乱藤蔓渐渐消失，崎岖地面变得平缓，遮天巨木连成一片绿海，将喧嚣与凶险尽数挡在外面。再前行数十步，眼前豁然开朗——天地被浓郁翠绿包裹，地势自然抬高，形成一方平坦高台，树影婆娑、光影斑驳，安静得能听见彼此的呼吸。
李紫云下意识停下脚步，仰头望着直冲天际的古木，眼中微亮，惊叹道：“这里也太不一样了吧……又安静又干净，连风都这么温柔，跟外面完全是两个地方。”
罗止正也收住脚步，手握长枪缓缓环顾四周，神色平静道：“我们走遍了碧叶林所有地方，这里是最中央。地势高，像一座天然高台，到处都是翠绿的树影。”
罗止正顿了顿，目光落回女孩身上，声音低沉清晰道：“以后，这里就叫翠影高台吧。”
李紫云轻声重复一遍，眉眼弯起，笑意清甜道：“翠影高台……好听，又好记，还特别贴合这里的样子！”
罗止正嘴角勾起一抹极淡的笑意，转瞬即逝，他抬手指向高台中央一片背靠巨木、视野开阔的空地，语气沉稳道：“这里挡风、遮雨、干燥，很适合定居。”
罗止正看向李紫云，眼神认真而温柔道：“我们在这里搭庇护所，一个属于我们两个人的庇护所。”
李紫云微微一怔，随即眼底泛起明亮的光，用力点头，声音里带着雀跃道：“好！这里，就是我们在琉璃岛的第一个家。”
夕阳渐渐沉向密林深处，天边染开一片昏黄，风里带着微凉的湿气，天色正一点点向黄昏沉去。
眼看天色不早，两人商议着今日先不急于动工，暂且在此休整一夜，等明日天亮再正式搭建居所。
他们分头捡拾枯枝与干燥的落叶，不多时便堆起一小堆干柴。罗止正从裤兜里掏出防水打火机点燃干柴，火光升起，驱散了林间的阴冷与暮色。
李紫云从储物袋中取出几块鲜嫩的灵猪肉，递到罗止正面前。
罗止正接过，抽出腰间骨刀，削了几根长短合适的树枝，将枝头削尖，把灵猪肉一块块细心串好，置于篝火边缘慢慢翻烤。
不多时，油脂滋滋滴落，香气在高台之上弥漫开来，将这片临时休整之地，烘出了淡淡的烟火气息。
两人分食着烤肉，奔波半日的疲惫渐渐散去，吃饱歇定，便伴着篝火余温沉沉睡去。
等到再次睁开眼时，天边已经泛起鱼肚白，清晨的微光穿过枝叶洒落，林间雾气渐散，崭新的一天，正式到来。
罗止正先撑着地面坐起身，腰背微微舒展，一夜的疲惫散了大半。他回头看了眼还闭着眼的女孩，放轻动作站起身，拍了拍裤腿上的草屑与泥土。
李紫云也跟着醒了过来，揉了揉惺忪的睡眼，睫毛在晨光里轻轻颤动。她撑着地起身，目光自然而然落在罗止正的背影上，轻声问道：“我们现在……就搭庇护所吗？”
罗止正转过身，点头应道：“对，现在就开始搭建庇护所。”
说干就干，两人立刻行动起来。
罗止正先将盘根铁木枪稳稳靠在巨木旁，抬手解下腰间的骨刀。他挽起早已破旧却依旧干净的衣袖，露出线条紧实、带着浅淡伤痕的手臂。他当过兵，野外生存与搭建庇护所的技巧早已刻在骨子里，一举一动利落有序。
罗止正看着空地，语气沉稳地安排道：“搭庇护所要选稳当的骨架支撑，咱们得砍几根粗壮笔直的枝干做顶梁，再备些细枝、藤蔓、树皮做围护。”
李紫云也学着他的样子，轻轻把盘根铁木弓跟箭囊放在巨木旁，小手攥了攥，眼神跃跃欲试道：“那我做什么？我能帮忙吗？”
罗止正看她一脸认真又略带紧张的模样，低笑一声，语气轻松调侃道：“当然能，咱们家第一个房子，总不能我一个人全包了。你负责捡干燥结实的细树枝、韧性强的长藤蔓，再挑些宽大完整的树干皮，越规整越好，别扎到手。”
李紫云脸颊微红，小声嘟囔一句，耳根悄悄泛粉道：“谁跟你‘咱们家’啊……”嘴上不承认，脚步却已经轻快地转身跑去捡拾材料。
罗止正看着她略显慌乱的背影，笑意更深，没有戳破，转身选定几根粗细适宜、长势笔直的侧枝。他握紧骨刀，找准枝干木纹最脆弱的节点，将骨刀精准切入，顺着木纹反复切割、撬动。骨刀轻松破开木质纤维，每一刀都落得稳准，不多时便将粗壮枝干的连接处彻底切断，再借力一推，碗口粗的枝干应声落地。
他接连砍了三根粗细均匀的粗枝干做顶梁，又砍了数十根中等枝干做椽子，再用骨刀削去枝干上的杂枝、凸起，将边缘打磨平整，避免划伤，也让搭建时衔接更紧密。
不多时，李紫云抱着一大捆干燥树枝、藤蔓跑了回来，怀里还夹着几片宽大厚实的树皮，额角渗出细密汗珠，脸颊红扑扑的。她喘着气，语气带着几分邀功道：“你看这些够不够？树枝我挑的都是最硬最干的，藤蔓也特别韧，树皮都是完整的！”
罗止正低头一看，女孩挑的材料果然笔直规整、长短均匀，显然是用心挑选过的。他伸手接过，指尖不经意擦过她的手背，两人同时微顿，气氛多了一丝微妙甜意。
罗止正轻咳一声，掩饰心底微漾道：“再去捡些干苔藓、软茅草，还有大块的平整石块，咱们铺地、砌火塘都用得上。”
李紫云应了一声，跑得更快，似在逃避，又似藏着一丝欢喜道：“知道啦！”
搭建正式开始。
content_en:
On the vast expanse of blue waves of the endless East China Sea, stands a vast and mysterious behemoth - Liuli Island.
This island is beyond imagination, with high mountains, hidden deep valleys, continuous swamps, and rolling forests, hiding countless unknown dangers and opportunities.
But even though it is so vast, Luo Zhizheng and Li Ziyun have tried their best and fought for survival since they traveled to the island, but they have only set foot on the edge and outermost corner of the island. And this area is the Biye Forest that they are currently exploring and are about to finish.
Fragmented and soft light penetrates the layers of green leaves, casting mottled green shadows on the ground. Luo Zhi was holding an iron-wood spear in his hand. The tip of the dark iron spear shone with a calm and cold light. The bone knife hung close to his waist. He walked steadily in front of him to clear the way. His eyes were sharp and steady, and he took every step firmly and cautiously.
Li Ziyun carried ten ironwood arrows on his back and an ironwood bow in his hand, following closely behind him. The girl who used to be flustered when things happened and jealous when injured, now has a bit of tenacity in her face and eyes, her hand holding the bow is steady and strong, her eyes are alert but no longer panicked, she can already stay by his side steadily and become a reliable companion.
The two people started from the rocky hill in the north and headed all the way towards the center of the Biye Forest. After about a stick of incense, they finally entered the last and most core area of ​​the Biye Forest.
The ancient trees here are so towering that they need several people to hug each other. The trunks are as straight as cast iron and reach into the sky. The canopies are layered and intertwined, opening up an endless natural canopy to isolate the scorching sun, strong winds and heavy rains. The terrain in the forest is gentle and open. There are no steep cliffs, no tangled thorns, no muddy depressions, and no rugged gravel like rock hills. Only the thick roots of giant trees are scattered and raised, paving the ground with natural high platforms and winding paths. Walking on them is stable and solid, and it is not easy to slip or get lost.
There is no damp and rotten smell in the air that is customary in the depths of the dense forest. Only the fragrance of vegetation and warm spiritual energy linger. The surroundings are so quiet that only the branches and leaves rustle and the breeze whispers.
Here is the center of the green leaf forest - the green shadow high platform.
This place is located on the east side of the dense forest along the coast of the Endless East China Sea, about 13 kilometers away from the shoals along the coast of the Endless East China Sea.
As the two of them walked deeper, the surrounding environment became more and more peaceful. The messy vines gradually disappeared, the rugged ground became gentle, and the giant trees covering the sky connected into a sea of ​​green, blocking out all the noise and danger. After walking a few dozen steps further, a vision suddenly opened up - the sky and the earth were wrapped in rich emerald green, and the terrain was naturally raised, forming a flat platform with whirling tree shadows and mottled light and shadow. It was so quiet that one could hear each other's breathing.
Li Ziyun subconsciously stopped and looked up at the ancient trees reaching into the sky. His eyes were slightly bright and he exclaimed: "It's so different here...it's quiet and clean, and even the wind is so gentle. It's completely different from the outside."
Luo Zhizheng also stopped walking, looked around slowly with a spear in hand, and said calmly: "We have traveled all over the Biye Forest, and this is the center. The terrain is high, like a natural high platform, and there are green tree shadows everywhere."
Luo Zhizheng paused, his gaze returned to the girl, and he said in a low and clear voice: "From now on, this place will be called Cuiying Gaotai."
Li Ziyun repeated it softly, his eyebrows arched, and he said with a sweet smile: "Cuiying Gaotai...it sounds good, it's easy to remember, and it fits the look of this place!"
A faint smile appeared at the corner of Luo Zhizheng's lips, and it disappeared in a flash. He raised his hand and pointed to an open space in the center of the high platform with a huge tree and a wide view. He said in a calm tone: "This place is windproof, rainproof, dry, and is very suitable for settling down."
Luo Zhizheng looked at Li Ziyun, his eyes serious and gentle, and said: "Let's build a shelter here, a shelter that belongs to the two of us."
Li Ziyun was startled for a moment, then a bright light appeared in his eyes, he nodded vigorously, and said with excitement in his voice: "Okay! This is our first home on Liuli Island."
The setting sun is gradually sinking into the depths of the dense forest, the sky is turning into a dim yellow, the wind is carrying a slightly cool moisture, and the sky is sinking into the dusk little by little.
Seeing that it was getting late, the two of them decided not to rush to start construction today, but to rest here overnight and wait until dawn tomorrow before officially building their residence.
They separated to pick up dead branches and dry leaves, and soon they piled up a small pile of dry firewood. Luo Zhi was taking out a waterproof lighter from his trouser pocket and lighting dry firewood. The fire rose, dispelling the coldness and dusk in the forest.
Li Ziyun took out a few pieces of fresh and tender pork belly from the storage bag and handed them to Luo Zhizheng.
Luo Zhizheng took it, took out the bone knife from his waist, cut a few branches of suitable length, sharpened the branches, carefully skewered the soul meat piece by piece, and placed it on the edge of the campfire to roast slowly.
After a while, the grease dripped, and the aroma spread over the high platform, giving this temporary resting place a faint smell of fireworks.
The two of them shared the barbecue, and the fatigue from running around for half a day gradually dissipated. After eating and resting, they fell asleep with the remaining warmth of the campfire.
When I opened my eyes again, the sky was already turning white, the early morning light shone through the branches and leaves, the fog in the forest gradually dispersed, and a new day had officially arrived.
Luo Zhizheng sat up first, leaning on the ground, stretching his back slightly, and most of the fatigue from the night was gone. He looked back at the girl whose eyes were still closed, stood up gently, and patted the grass clippings and soil on his trouser legs.
Li Ziyun also woke up and rubbed his sleepy eyes, his eyelashes trembling slightly in the morning light. She stood up with support on the ground, her eyes naturally fell on Luo Zhizheng's back, and asked softly: "Shall we... build a shelter now?"
Luo Zhizheng turned around, nodded and said, "Yes, let's start building the shelter now."
Just do it, the two of them took action immediately.
Luo Zhizheng first placed the iron-wood spear firmly against the giant tree, then raised his hand to untie the bone knife from his waist. He rolled up his worn but still clean sleeves, revealing his tight-lined arms with light scars. He had served as a soldier, and the skills of surviving in the wild and building shelters were already engraved in his bones, and his every move was neat and orderly.
Luo Zhi was looking at the open space and arranged in a calm tone: "To build a shelter, we need to choose a stable frame to support it. We have to cut a few thick and straight branches to make the roof, and prepare some twigs, vines, and bark for the enclosure."
Li Ziyun also followed his example and gently placed the ironwood bow and quiver next to the giant tree. He clenched his little hands and asked with eager eyes: "Then what should I do? Can I help?"
Luo Zhizheng looked at her serious and slightly nervous look, chuckled, and joked in a relaxed tone: "Of course, I can't take care of the first house in our family by myself. You are responsible for picking up dry and strong twigs, strong long vines, and some wide and complete trunk bark. The more regular the better, so as not to get stuck in your hands."
Li Ziyun's cheeks were slightly red, and she murmured in a low voice, her ears turning pink: "Who told you 'our family'..." He didn't admit it, but he turned around and ran to pick up materials briskly.
Luo Zhi was looking at her slightly flustered back with a deeper smile without breaking it. He turned around and selected a few side branches of suitable thickness and straight growth. He held the bone knife tightly, found the weakest node of the wood grain of the branch, cut the bone knife accurately, and repeatedly cut and pried along the wood grain. The bone knife easily broke through the wood fibers, and each cut was made accurately. In a short time, the joints of the thick branches were completely cut off, and with another push, the branches as thick as the mouth of the bowl fell to the ground.
He cut three thick branches of uniform thickness to make the roof beam, and cut dozens of medium branches to make the rafters. He then used a bone knife to cut off the miscellaneous branches and bulges on the branches, and polished the edges smooth to avoid scratches and make the connection closer during construction.
Not long after, Li Ziyun ran back with a large bundle of dry branches and vines, and a few wide and thick pieces of bark in his arms. Fine beads of sweat oozed from his forehead, and his cheeks were flushed. She gasped and said with a hint of credit: "Do you think these are enough? I picked the hardest and driest branches, the vines are also very tough, and the bark is intact!"
Luo Zhizheng lowered his head and saw that the materials the girl picked were indeed straight, regular, and even in length. It was obvious that they had been carefully selected. He reached out to take it, and his fingertips inadvertently brushed the back of her hand. They both paused slightly at the same time, adding a subtle sweetness to the atmosphere.
Luo Zhizheng coughed slightly, hiding the slight excitement in his heart and said: "Go and pick up some dry moss, soft thatch, and large flat stones. We can use them for paving the floor and building fire pits."
Li Ziyun responded, running faster, as if escaping, but also hiding a trace of joy: "I know!"
Construction officially begins.
title_en: Chapter 15: Looking for a beautiful place in the ancient forest and building a new home on a high platform Chapter 16: The green shadow kills the giant rat and the spiritual meal breaks through the ordinary level
